mamba_refuted: 8,4096,80,256,64,128: flat seed [64,128,64]s2=292us vs persistent_blocked=561us / persistent_interleaved=556us = 1.9x SLOWER. Mechanism confirmed = OCCUPANCY not launch-overhead: mamba launches ~10240 tiny CTAs the HW scheduler overlaps to hide latency; persistent launches ~num_sm CTAs that serialize the dots in a loop -> removes the inter-CTA parallelism.
bare_gemm_complement: persistent_blocked num_sm_multiplier=1 vs flat seed (G vs cuBLAS), by grid_m/grid_n ratio: wide 0.57 -0.72/-0.25/-0.25 CATASTROPHIC; ratio1 -2%; ratio2 small(2048^3,1-wave) -3.2%; ratio2 BIG 4096^3 +3.5%, 8192^3 +7% (->0.997 near cuBLAS parity); ratio4 (8192,4096,4096) +2.2%; ratio64 tall neutral(already l2).
viable_gate: persistent_blocked m=1 wins on LARGE non-wide compute-bound GEMMs: grid_m>=grid_n AND many-waves (total_tiles>>num_sm). CATASTROPHIC on wide (grid_n>grid_m) and neutral/negative on small(1-wave)/ratio1. persistent_interleaved is safe-but-flat everywhere.

finding: CONFIRMED. Two caps conflated under one 4-wave threshold have DIFFERENT correct behavior:
num_stages_cap: REAL occupancy crossover. std dot [64,128]: 0.48w s4=10.7(best) s2=12.4(+16%); 1.94w s4=14.8~=s2=15.0; 7.76w s2=36.6(best) s4=43.9(+20%). Crossover ~3-4 waves -> threshold 4 is ROUGHLY OK.
tile_cap: THE BUG. Large-per-dot fused dot (hd=128,ds=256) [64,128] beats [128,256] at EVERY pinned incl 0.12 waves (pinned=16: 12.4 vs 13.9; pinned=256: 29.3 vs 32.5; pinned=512: 51.6 vs 57.2). NOT occupancy-driven -- the fused dot is memory-bound (decay traffic) so a big register-reuse tile just wastes occupancy. Wins from ~0 waves, but heuristic only caps at 4 waves.
diabolical_kernel: mamba hd=128,ds=256, pinned_grid in [132,528) (1-4 waves, e.g. batch=1 few heads): gets [128,256]s4, wants [64,128]s2 -> 10-12% loss. Attribution: the TILE ([64,128]~=[128,128] << [128,256]), NOT the stages.
fix_direction: decouple the caps: tile cap should key on oversized-fused-dot-tile (pinned>1 + large per-dot tile), NOT occupancy; num_stages cap keeps its ~4-wave occupancy threshold. CAVEAT: need a compute-bound bmm experiment -- a big-K batched GEMM may want the big tile, so tile cap likely needs a memory-bound gate, not just pinned>1.
decision: presented to user; not yet built (frozen champion; needs bmm experiment + validation).
